programme.title: The Courts
programme.sub-title: Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson Discusses Her Memoir, Lovely One
programme.desc: U.S. Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson discusses her memoir, Lovely One, with Judge Richard Gergel of the U.S. District Court for the District of South Carolina. This is part of the American Law Institute's 2026 annual meeting.

programme.title: America 250
programme.sub-title: Supreme Court Justice Amy Coney Barrett on U.S. Constitution
programme.desc: Supreme Court Justice Amy Coney Barrett discusses her path to the U.S. Supreme Court and how she interprets the Constitution; she's the author of the book Listening to the Law: Reflections on the Court and Constitution.

programme.title: Justice Anthony Kennedy, Life, Law & Liberty
programme.desc: Retired Supreme Court Associate Justice Anthony Kennedy talks about his memoir, Life, Law & Liberty.

programme.title: Peter Cohen, In the Supreme Court's Own Words
programme.desc: Constitutional law scholar Peter Cohen considers the lessons to be learned from Supreme Court Justice Robert Jackson - an FDR appointee - and his interpretation of the U.S. Constitution.

programme.title: Lectures in History
programme.desc: History professor Lawrence Cappello analyzes Supreme Court cases that address the right to privacy, focusing on police and phone wiretaps.

programme.title: Q & A
programme.sub-title: SCOTUSblog's Sarah Isgur on the Inner Workings of the Supreme Court - Part 1
programme.desc: SCOTUSblog editor Sarah Isgur, author of Last Branch Standing, talks about the current Supreme Court, the cases it takes up, and the divisions she sees among the justices, based on their ideology and institutional outlook.

programme.title: Q & A
programme.sub-title: SCOTUSblog's Sarah Isgur on the Inner Workings of the Supreme Court - Part 2
programme.desc: SCOTUSblog editor Sarah Isgur, author of Last Branch Standing, talks about the power of Chief Justice John Roberts, the personalities and influence of the other justices, and her relationship with Justice Elena Kagan.

programme.title: The Courts
programme.sub-title: Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson Discusses Her Memoir, Lovely One
programme.desc: U.S. Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson discusses her memoir, Lovely One, with Judge Richard Gergel of the U.S. District Court for the District of South Carolina. This is part of the American Law Institute's 2026 annual meeting.

programme.title: America 250
programme.sub-title: C-SPAN Tours U.S. Army Museum Call to Arms Exhibit
programme.desc: Museum of the U.S. Army Chief Curator Paul Morando gives C-SPAN's American History TV a tour of the museum's Call to Arms: The Soldier and the Revolutionary War special exhibit.

programme.title: Kathleen Duval, Independence Lost - Lives on the Edge of the American Revolution
programme.desc: Pulitzer Prize-winning historian Kathleen Duval examines how Native Americans, enslaved people, individuals on the Gulf Coast and others outside colonial society shaped the Revolutionary War.

programme.title: Andrew Lyter, Going Among English Sailors
programme.desc: Book TV presents coverage of the 2025 History Book Festival in Lewes, Delaware.

programme.title: Lectures in History
programme.desc: University of Louisville history professor Matthew Goldberg chronicles the 1898 Spanish-American War, fought primarily in Cuba, Guam, and the Philippines.

programme.title: C-SPAN Tours the National WWI Museum & Memorial
programme.desc: C-SPAN tours the National World War One Museum in Kansas City, Missouri, which explores the Great War through the stories and artifacts of those who lived it.

programme.title: Reel America
programme.sub-title: U.S. Women Prisoners of War -- World War II
programme.desc: A 1985 Department of Defense film shares the oral histories of Army and Navy nurse prisoners of war captured after the fall of Bataan and Corregidor in World War II.

programme.title: David Nasaw, The Wounded Generation
programme.desc: Book TV presents coverage of the 2025 Miami Book Fair.

programme.title: 1950 Korean War Battle of Chosin Reservoir
programme.desc: American History TV presents coverage of the 2025 American Veterans Center Conference in Washington, D.C, including discussions on the Korean War, Vietnam War and World War II.

programme.title: Q & A
programme.sub-title: Author Wil Haygood on Black American Soldiers in the Vietnam War
programme.desc: Former Washington Post correspondent Wil Haygood, author of The War Within a War, discusses the experience of Black American soldiers in Vietnam and the struggle for racial equality, happening at the same time, back home in the United States.

programme.title: The Presidency
programme.sub-title: The End of Operation Desert Storm
programme.desc: Desert Storm veteran Stephen Bourque chronicles the end of the Gulf War in 1991. He spoke at the George H.W. Bush Presidential Library in Texas.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Anaheim Ducks at Vegas Golden Knights
programme.desc: The Ducks take on the Golden Knights at T-Mobile Arena for Game 2 of the West second round. Vegas leads the series after a 3-1 Game 1 win. Mitch Marner had a 162-foot empty-netter and an assist. Carter Hart was sensational, stopping 33 of 34 shots.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Vegas Golden Knights at Anaheim Ducks
programme.desc: The West second round Game 3 gets underway as the Golden Knights play the Ducks at Honda Center. The series is tied. Anaheim used speed to stifle Vegas, with Jansen Harkins sealing the Game 2 win with an empty-net goal with 3:30 remaining.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Vegas Golden Knights at Anaheim Ducks
programme.desc: The Ducks face the Golden Knights in Game 4 of the West second round at Honda Center. The Golden Knights lead 2-1 after a 6-2 Game 3 win. In Game 3, Mitch Marner had a historic performance, recording his first playoff hat trick and four points.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Anaheim Ducks at Vegas Golden Knights
programme.desc: Jack Eichel leads the Golden Knights against Leo Carlsson and the surging Ducks in Game 4 with the series that is tied 2-2. After Anaheim's 4-3 victory in the last outing, Vegas relies on Jack Eichel's 10 postseason points to reclaim the series lead.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Vegas Golden Knights at Anaheim Ducks
programme.desc: The Golden Knights visit the Ducks for a crucial Game 6 of the Western Conference round. Pavel Dorofeyev scored 2 goals along with the game-winning goal in matchround 5 . Following an overtime loss in last match, the Knights lead this series 3-2.

programme.desc: Ulises trabaja en la aduana. Un día, su amigo Raúl lo convence para que lo ayude a pasar por la frontera diamantes robados, sin saber que este negocio no solo los pondrá en peligro a ellos, sino a aquellos que aman.

programme.title: Heredero del diablo

programme.title: Cine

Cuenta la historia de Gabriel, un profesor de filosofía y lógica de la secundaria. Atraviesa problemas conyugales, al conocer a una nueva y joven alumna, quien desaparecerá al acercarlo a los dibujos proféticos de Benjamín Solari Parravicini.

programme.sub-title: Volver a las raíces en Tennessee

programme.title: Las renovadoras
programme.desc: Mina y su equipo tienen la casa familiar de la jefa de obra de Two Chicks, en la zona rural de New Castle. Para conseguir el mejor precio para su cliente, Mina debe averiguar cómo salir de su zona de confort urbana y adaptarse a un mercado más rural.

programme.title: Las renovadoras
programme.desc: Mina y el equipo regresan a Bates-Hendricks para reformar un segundo hogar en la calle Singleton. Con techos abovedados y una habitación secreta en la cocina, esta casa necesita un elemento sorpresa para atraer a los compradores.

programme.title: Las renovadoras
programme.desc: Mina y el equipo llegan a Irvington para renovar una encantadora casa histórica en Hill Street. Tras tener problemas con el ayuntamiento, Mina tiene mucho trabajo para crear una villa ecléctica de estilo manteniendo su integridad histórica.

programme.title: Las renovadoras
programme.desc: Mina y el equipo regresan a Bates-Hendricks para renovar una casa con una ampliación de dos pisos y una habitación, pero luego de encontrar graves problemas en la estructura, Mina debe ajustarse al presupuesto para crear una casa fuerte.

programme.title: Las renovadoras
programme.desc: Tras perder dinero en su última casa, Mina y el equipo esperan ganar dinero haciendo una nueva construcción de lujo en el lote lindero. Mina quiere destacar esa insípida casa con puertas antiguas, pero un percance podría descarrilar el proyecto.

programme.title: Las renovadoras

programme.title: Desaparecidos

programme.title: Desaparecidos

programme.title: Desaparecidos

programme.title: Mirreyes vs. Godínez 2: El retiro

programme.title: Después de ti

programme.title: Cuernito Armani
programme.desc: La vida de un hombre se complica cuando debe cumplir el deseo de su padre agonizante: presentarle a su novia, que no tiene. Tendrá que buscarla sin imaginar que la vida le tiene una grata sorpresa.

programme.title: El ejecutor
programme.desc: El asesinato de un político desencadena una lucha entre la justicia y el crimen organizado. El agente Mauro Pardo y Violeta investigarán un proyecto llamado "Visión 2000" y su relación con el asesinato.

programme.title: La princesa
programme.desc: Al negarse a casarse con un capo de la droga, Grecia está decidida a pagar ella misma la deuda de su padre. Para ganar el dinero, decide apostar en los palenques de Sinaloa, donde conoce a Armando.

programme.title: Anna antinarcóticos
programme.desc: Una detective rebelde quiere seguir los pasos de su fallecido padre y se une a un colega transferido de Los Ángeles a Miami. Juntos desatan una guerra sin prisioneros contra las drogas.

programme.title: Regresando a mis raíces

programme.title: Las monjas del narco

programme.title: Guerra de mafias
